description: Data that is understood by looking at it: a self-contained HTML visualization the portal renders and the chat can cite
client_copy: Los gráficos, paneles y comparaciones que se entienden de una mirada, en Artefactos.
_comment: IT DEPENDS ON kanban for the same reason deliverable does: an artifact is
produced BY a ticket and cited FROM it.
IT WAS NOT ON EVERY ROLE, and that asymmetry died with the roster: marketing,
sales and accounting had things worth drawing and support and assistant did
not, so `roles/skills_split.py` kept this skill out of two teammates'
indexes. One baptized agent per client has one index and it is the client's,
so the distinction has nowhere left to live: `system: true` ships the FOLDER
to every agent so anything may depend on it, and the skill is delivered like
every other one in the kit.
